rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and the provided 3AA label, but it overstates certainty from the image by claiming clearly compact A-grade ICM, cohesive A-grade TE, symmetric expansion, and absence of debris/fragmentation that are not all confidently discernible in this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, prior IVF outcomes including prior live birth, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and protocol with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, and the probability estimate is tied to embryo quality and patient modifiers; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and overinterpretation of morphology.

Much of the response is evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, but recommendations such as ERA, endometrial scratching, NK-cell testing/intralipids, broad thrombophilia workup, and routine PGT-A in this context are more controversial and not strongly guideline-supported.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer technique, luteal support considerations, SET, and contingency planning, though some suggested adjuncts/workups are controversial and may reduce appropriateness.
